items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Pearl Bailey and the band on the road with Louie.

ctx.x: No, I was home. I knew both of them; Pearl and I were friends.

No, we was at the Howard Theatre, and Pearl was getting ready to start working in a white club there, and she happened to be across the street from the stage -- that's where everybody eat, and so forth, and Louie was coming out, and I said, "Louie, come here, I want for you to meet Pearl Bailey." "Pearl Bailey?" He said, "Well, naturally." He said I'm opening tonight at the club so and so, and I wish you'd bring Louie with you tonight after you get through." I said, "Sure" and we went over there, and Pearl opened…

And that night, we went to a place uptown, in Georgetown, to a place where they had food, and we ate, and Pearl Bailey had a Buick, was driving a Buick, and we was living downtown -- Louie and me, we were living downtown, so I said, "I got to go now", so she said, "Well, take my car".
